sections.title: Replace parameterized SELECT with string-interpolated IN clause in update_link_info
sections.rationale: The single hunk rewrites the SELECT that follows the executemany UPDATE, swapping a bound-parameter query for one that f-strings user-supplied URLs directly into the SQL text, introducing a SQL injection vector.
